---
title: "OS non-proportional hazards — fitting"
subtitle: "Supporting analysis using five imputations"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This computationally reduced supporting analysis uses fixed imputations 1–5.
The time-varying treatment effect relaxes the proportional-hazards assumption.

```{r}
#| label: fit-supporting-os-nph
#| include: false

source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
force <- identical(Sys.getenv("LIQPLAT_FORCE"), "1")
indices <- config$imputation$supporting$indices
imputations <- readRDS(here::here(
  "artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations.rds"
))
model_dir <- here::here(
  "artifacts", "supporting", "os-non-proportional-hazards"
)
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

for (index in indices) {
  model_path <- file.path(model_dir, sprintf("model-%02d.rds", index))
  if (!force && file.exists(model_path)) next

  completed_data <- mice::complete(imputations, index) |>
    dplyr::mutate(mgps = factor(mgps, levels = 0:2))

  # The intervention participant censored on day zero remains in the completed
  # dataset used for standardization but cannot contribute to model fitting.
  fitting_data <- completed_data |>
    dplyr::filter_out(survival_time_days == 0)

  model <- rstanarm::stan_surv(
    formula = survival::Surv(survival_time_days, event_death) ~
      tve(tx, df = 3, degree = 3) +
      ecog_binary + stage_binary + lung + mgps,
    data = fitting_data,
    chains = 4L,
    iter = 1000L,
    warmup = 500L,
    cores = 4L,
    basehaz = "ms",
    basehaz_ops = list(df = 5),
    seed = analysis_seed(config, "supporting", index)
  )

  saveRDS(model, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```
